title: The Gate Left Open
sentences: One story says the city fell because someone left a small gate open.
The gate was called the Kerkoporta, a little side door in the land walls.
The historian Doukas wrote that on May 29, it was left open by accident.
He said about fifty Ottoman soldiers got in through it.
But most eyewitnesses never mention it.
And excavations have found no matching gate in the inner wall there.
Many historians now treat the story as legend.
Follow for more from the fall of Constantinople.
caption:
